modules.module_title: Shift hand over and take charge in speed frame department

pcs.pc_description: report for the shift 10-15 minutes prior to the scheduled time with necessary operational tools
collect the shift details from previous shift operator on production, maintenance, raw material, colour coding, etc. as per the SOP
check for quality and the availability of spares/ production materials (i.e., sliver cans, roving bobbin, bobbin trolley, spare empties, etc.)
monitor condition of processing materials and accessories in the allotted speed frames such as sliver passage, roving formation, run outs, roller lapping, OHTC, waste collection box, etc.
report idle spindles, length variation between the bobbins and other observed deviations to incoming shift supervisor
check work spot and speed frame machine for cleanliness as per specifications
provide shift details to incoming shift operator on production, maintenance, spare parts, counts running, count changes, maintenance schedule, sliver cans availability, etc. as per the SOP
complete the shift end jobs like mark hank meter reading, writing production log report, waste collection box disposal, cleaning as per standard protocol
report deviation to incoming shift supervisor on production, maintenance, absenteeism, etc.
get clearance from shift operator and shift supervisor before leaving the shift
operate speed frame machine using control buttons provided for starting, inching, stopping, emergency stopping, doff length resetting, lowering and lifting spindle/bobbin rails, etc.
operate machine display panel and check functioning of machine
follow the different signal lamps used in speed frame machines
fix safety covers, waste collection chamber doors as per the guidelines
dismantle and assemble detachable spares like top arm, top drafting rollers, clearers, flyer, etc.

modules.module_title: Attend speed frame for sliver can change

pcs.pc_description: identify the can exhaust as per the standard guidelines
transfer supply sliver cans from storage to speed frame creel area as per specified colour code and count
piece full can sliver with running cans sliver before exhaustion as per the SOP
remove exhausted cans from creel and store at specified place

modules.module_title: Piece broken sliver in the speed frame

pcs.pc_description: identify roving and sliver breakages as per the SOP in the allotted speed frame machines
perform piecing of broken sliver at creel as per standard procedure
monitor the sliver passage in the running machine
collect sliver waste in the waste collection pocket to dispose in the waste collection box

modules.module_title: Piece broken roving in the speed frame

pcs.pc_description: piece the broken roving using blowhorn or nylon wire as per standard procedure
fix the roving bobbin in the spindle after piecing as per standard method
identify the formation of roving as per the standard requirement after switching on the machine

modules.module_title: Prepare for doffing in the speed frame

pcs.pc_description: identify the doffing stage of the running speed frame machine
segregate empty bobbins for doff as per the colour code requirements
load the required number of empty bobbins in trolley as per requirement
move the bobbin trolleys at the specified location for the doffing activity
operate the overhead blower as per the standard guidelines

modules.module_title: Perform doffing in the speed frame

pcs.pc_description: open the safety door as per standard procedure
doff full bobbins and fix empty bobbins as per standard procedure
wind roving end with the empty bobbin as per the standard procedure
identify the restarting breaks as per the SOP
report to the supervisor and maintenance team for machine malfunction
transport filled bobbin trolley to storage area
fix prepared doff slip in the full bobbins trolley
cover the material after post doffing as per standard method using given material

modules.module_title: Perform cleaning and other tenting activities in the speed frame

pcs.pc_description: clean the empty bobbins as per the instruction
examine the build quality of the roving bobbin
segregate the sliver waste and roving waste count wise and store in the respective waste bins
support count change team, doffing team, maintenance team within the limits of responsibility
remove roller lapping as per the standard procedure
clean the creeling zone, top roll clearer, drafting zone, machine backside, spindle and bobbin rails at specified intervals
